confirmed_source_properties: JobObjectBasicProcessIdList class 3 uses two DWORD counts and a bounded ULONG_PTR-compatible SIZE_T array of 4096 PIDs. Incomplete, oversized, duplicate and invalid PID snapshots fail closed before acceptance.

Every snapshot member is opened noninheritable with SYNCHRONIZE | PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION and verified by IsProcessInJob against the exact owned job. Partial capture failures close retained handles and remain cleanup errors.
The caller defers catchable interruption across capture and return-value adoption, preventing a successful native OpenProcess handle from being discarded before cleanup ownership.
Before termination, cumulative TotalProcesses must equal the unique captured member PID set plus known root identity. Any unobserved historical descendant prevents a clean completion claim.

After TerminateJobObject, retained root and every captured member handle are waited to signaling with one shared absolute cleanup deadline. Exit codes or job counters never replace those per-process waits.
Retained member/root/thread references close after the wait attempts and before final active accounting drain. Query/capture/request/wait/close/drain errors remain fatal; no exception hides them.

Final cumulative TotalProcesses must equal the pre-capture total. A new process created during capture or termination permanently increments the lifetime count and therefore fails closed even if absent from later PID snapshots.

The Windows proof receipt validator now requires exactly one typed lifetime process, active zero and limit-terminated zero for every accepted verifier run. This confines successful proof qualification to the actual single-process verifier commands and rejects unseen prior descendants on the success path.

primary_sources.supports: WAIT_TIMEOUT is nonsignaled; WAIT_OBJECT_0 is the process completion predicate.
External termination is asynchronous and requires a retained-handle wait to establish completion.
Job termination requests termination of associated processes and nested descendants.
Snapshot structure and complete member counts, including nested child-job processes.
Exact-job membership accepts QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION process access.
TotalProcesses is a lifetime counter including terminated or failed-limit associations; conservative coverage mismatch is permitted.
Job-handle signaling is tied to the end-of-job time-limit event, not a generic completion barrier.
Active-zero notification is accounting; ordinary notification delivery is not guaranteed and PID identity requires retained handles.

limitations: The count-coverage argument assumes the existing exclusive unnamed/noninherited job, no breakaway and bounded member/count limits; failures or uncertainty reject rather than certify closure.

The accepted proof harness is deliberately one process per Windows proof command. This source review does not certify general historical descendant tracking for arbitrary generic API callers.
